title: Tonies Sulley Audio Play Character from Disney's Monsters Inc.
features: Mike and Sully are two monsters working together to scare kids at the largest scream-processing factory. When a little girl, Boo, follows Sulley back into the monster world, he finds his career in jeopardy and his life turned upside down.
Teaches children about building friendships, teamwork and not judging a book by its cover.
Includes Disney Monsters, Inc with 4 songs, 1 story and total run time of approximately 33 minutes. Recommended Age Range: 4+, Language: English, Narrated by Dom DeLuise.
Tracklist: Songs: If I Didn’t Have You, It’s Our Job, Under the Bed, I Only Have Eye For You. Story: Monsters, Inc.
Requires Toniebox Audio Player to play audio; sold separately.
